stories.title: AI robot tech bros dogs run wild in Berlin gallery
stories.summary: In Germany, robotic AI dogs with the faces of tech's most powerful men are on the loose — courtesy of American artist Beeple.

stories.title: ICRC President Mirjana Spoljaric warns of the war's impact on civilians
stories.summary: The ICRC president talks about her recent trip to Iran, and warns about the impact of the Iran war on civilians.

stories.title: Iran war shakes Global economy as energy costs surge and recession fears grow
stories.summary: From energy markets to everyday prices, the fallout from the Iran war is reshaping the global economy.

stories.title: Comedian Sheng Wang on finding joy in the mundane
stories.summary: In his new Netflix special, comedian Sheng Wang elevates mundane moments - like picking a toothbrush - into punchlines. NPR's Emily Feng talks to the comedian about where he finds joy.

stories.title: An inevitable rise in Chinese-made EVs in America?
stories.summary: Chinese-made EVs that are not currently legally sold in the U.S. are making their way across the border anyway, says Wall Street Journal reporter Ryan Felton, who recently covered a rise in interest in the vehicles.

stories.title: Is there a 'standard' Indian body?
stories.summary: India recently published a survey to 'standardize' the Indian body sizes, so its manufacturers don't have to use the U.S. and E.U. sizes for a billion people. But is there a 'standard' Indian body?
